about: Human-judged corpus for choosing and tuning the embedding spec. Grades: 2 = strong (show it when viewing the other), 1 = moderate (related, lower in a list), 0 = weak/unrelated. Tags: hard-negative = shares words but not meaning; truncation = the relevant content sits at the end of a long text. See README.md.

A little about me: I grew up on the east side of town, went to the state university for a couple of years, and then spent most of my twenties working in retail management before switching careers into accounting. I married my high school sweetheart, and we have three kids who keep us busy with school plays, soccer practice, and endless science fair projects. We moved to this neighborhood about six years ago because we wanted a bigger yard and a shorter commute. I volunteer at the library book sale every spring, I sing (badly) in our congregation's choir, and on most Friday nights you will find our family at the pizza place on Main Street. I read a lot of historical fiction, I am slowly learning to play the ukulele, and I am the person on our street who always has jumper cables. My wife says I talk too much about the weather, which is probably true. I also keep a small vegetable patch, mostly tomatoes and zucchini, and I have a soft spot for old pickup trucks even though I have never owned one. What I really want to find here, though, is other people who keep honeybees: I started two hives last spring, lost one over the winter, and I would love a mentor, someone to share an extractor with, and advice on treating for varroa mites.
